WordNet Release 3.1 · English definitions, examples and parts of speech.
WordNet 3.1 Copyright 2011 by Princeton University. All rights reserved.
https://wordnet.princeton.edu/ | https://wordnet.princeton.edu/license-and-commercial-use
Original database distribution: https://wordnetcode.princeton.edu/wn3.1.dict.tar.gz
Source archive SHA-256: 3f7d8be8ef6ecc7167d39b10d66954ec734280b5bdcd57f7d9eafe429d11c22a

Modifications: converted the four WordNet lexical data tables (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) into offline JSON shards; used index.sense ranking and semantic concordance tag counts to sort actual senses; joined synonymous spelling variants only at normalized lookup keys. Preserved individual glosses and available textual usage examples. Indexed attested part-of-speech-specific exception-table forms (e.g. went → go and geese → goose) when they point to a lemma and matching part of speech in this release. Omitted synset graph relationships, frames and lexicographer metadata. This is not a full grammar or a bilingual translator. No endorsement is implied.

The text below from the 3.1 database headers applies to the WordNet data and its modifications.
